# value => session.custom.LineDropdown  (array of dicts)
	
	TAG_PROVIDER = "default"    # <-- change if your tags aren't under [default]
	
	# 1) Filter out the "All" row and keep only entries with numeric IDs
	lines = []
	for x in (value or []):
	    val = x.get("value")
	    try:
	        val_int = int(val)
	        lines.append({
	            "id": val_int,
	            "label": x.get("label") or str(val_int),
	            "eqPath": (x.get("EquipmentPath") or "").strip("/")
	        })
	    except:
	        pass  # skip non-numeric (e.g., "All")
	
	# 2) Build tag paths: two per line (icon + color)
	readPaths = []
	for ln in lines:
	    base = "[%s]%s/OEE_Events/" % (TAG_PROVIDER, ln["eqPath"])
	    readPaths.append(base + "stateIcon")
	    readPaths.append(base + "stateColor")
	
	# 3) Bulk read
	results = system.tag.readBlocking(readPaths) if readPaths else []
	
	# 4) Map results back into items list
	items = []
	for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
	    icon_qv  = results[i*2]   if i*2   < len(results) else None
	    color_qv = results[i*2+1] if i*2+1 < len(results) else None
	
	    icon_val  = icon_qv.value  if icon_qv and icon_qv.quality.isGood()  else None
	    color_val = color_qv.value if color_qv and color_qv.quality.isGood() else None
	
	    # Normalize icon: if you store names like "play-circle", prefix a library (material/)
	    icon_path = "material/help-circle"
	    if icon_val:
	        s = str(icon_val)
	        icon_path = s if ("/" in s or s.startswith("resource:")) else ("material/" + s)
	
	    laneColor = color_val or "#6C757D"
	
	    items.append({
	        "id": ln["id"],
	        "label": ln["label"],
	        "iconConfig": {
	            "path":  icon_path,
	            "color": laneColor,
	            "style": {"marginRight": 6}
	        },
	        # Optional cosmetics:
	        "headerStyle": {"fontWeight": "600"},
	        "rowStyle":    {"borderBottom": "1px solid #eee"}
	    })

	return items
